meta.source: Computed CSS custom properties audited from the live investigative-ai application (internal endpoints redacted)
meta.author: Prince Cobb

color.note: investigative-ai ships dark-only (html.dark). Values are the exact computed custom properties from the live app. Contrast ratios in each usage note were computed per WCAG 2.1.

tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: App canvas / page background — bottom rung of the dark-mode surface ladder (elevation −1). Source var: --background.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Shell chrome: sidebar and app frame (elevation 0). Source vars: --surface-0, --sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards and sections (elevation 1). text-primary on it: 14.76:1 AAA. Source vars: --card, --surface-1.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Nested panels, hover rows, wells inside cards (elevation 2). text-primary: 12.75:1 AAA. Source var: --surface-2.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, tooltips — topmost surface (elevation 3); also the muted fill. Source vars: --popover, --muted.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Inset fills that read as recessed, not raised: search inputs, quiet secondary buttons. Source var: --secondary.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. 17.65:1 on surface-canvas, 14.76:1 on surface-1 — AAA everywhere on the ladder. Source var: --foreground.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: sublabels, timestamps, helper copy. 11.67:1 on canvas, 9.76:1 on surface-1 — AAA. Source var: --muted-foreground.

tokens.name: text-sidebar
tokens.usage: Resting sidebar nav labels. 9.24:1 on surface-0 — AAA. Source var: --sidebar-foreground.

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Brand blue: primary buttons, active nav, links. 6.37:1 on surface-canvas — AA as text, passes 3:1 as a UI fill. Source var: --primary.

tokens.name: brand-on-primary
tokens.usage: Ink on brand-primary fills. 6.17:1 on brand-primary — AA. Source var: --primary-foreground.

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: Deep accent fill for selected/emphasis bands. Use with brand-on-accent only. Source var: --accent.

tokens.name: brand-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on brand-accent. 6.47:1 — AA. Source var: --accent-foreground.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on every interactive element. 5.02:1 on canvas — clears the 3:1 non-text minimum. Source var: --ring.

tokens.name: state-success
tokens.usage: Positive state text/icons (deltas, healthy counts). 10.59:1 on canvas — AAA. Source var: --success.

tokens.name: state-warning
tokens.usage: Warning / on-hold state text and icons. 12.06:1 on canvas — AAA. Source var: --warning.

tokens.name: state-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive and error text/icons. 6.78:1 on canvas — AA. Source var: --destructive.

tokens.name: state-info
tokens.usage: Informational state: unread 'New' notification badges. 7.26:1 on canvas — AAA. Source var: --info.

tokens.name: state-on-fill
tokens.usage: Ink on solid success/warning/info fills. Source vars: --success-foreground, --warning-foreground, --info-foreground.

tokens.name: badge-open-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the 'Open' case-status badge, as computed live.

tokens.name: badge-open-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the 'Open' badge. 9.21:1 on badge-open-bg — AAA.

tokens.name: badge-open-border
tokens.usage: Hairline on the 'Open' badge; one lightness step above its fill.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards and controls. 2.0:1 on canvas — FAILS the 3:1 non-text minimum, so decorative only: any meaningful boundary must also change fill or text. Source var: --border.

tokens.name: border-sidebar
tokens.usage: Divider inside the shell/sidebar; intentionally quieter than border-default. Source var: --sidebar-border.

tokens.name: nav-selected
tokens.usage: Selected / hover fill for sidebar nav items. Source var: --sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First categorical chart series. Source var: --chart-1.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second categorical chart series. Source var: --chart-2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third categorical chart series; differs from chart-2 in lightness, not hue alone. Source var: --chart-4 in source.

families.sans: Geist, -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: 'Geist Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen: the page greeting/title.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: KPI numbers in stat cards. Tight negative tracking keeps wide numerals compact.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section headers (rendered uppercase, +10% tracking). The only wide-tracked style in the system.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy; 1.5 line-height from the base scale.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI copy: table cells, notification descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, badges, nav items — interactive labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Stat deltas and fine print; often in a state color.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Case IDs, timestamps and other machine-ish metadata.

spacing.note: 4px base grid (Tailwind scale observed in source).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps; badge inner spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; stacked label/value pairs.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List-row vertical rhythm; badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps between related elements.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards in the KPI band and dashboard zones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Zone separation: between dashboard bands; page margins.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls, buttons, inputs and status badges (0.75rem — source var --radius).

tokens.name: radius-section
tokens.usage: Cards and section containers (0.875rem — source var --radius-section). One step softer than controls.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, dot indicators.

shadow.note: Elevation is carried by the surface ladder, not shadows; the single shadow is a whisper.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: The only shadow in the system (source var --shadow-xs); surfaces separate by lightness instead.
